proposedManifest.name: MCU Prep: Thor: Ragnarok (2017)
proposedManifest.description: Asgard burns and Thor has to decide what kind of king he'll be when the throne, the hammer, and even his home can't save him. Trace his journey from brash warrior to humbled hero, then dive into the literal comic story that shares the film's name and apocalyptic stakes.
proposedManifest.sourceOrigin: Selected by raymond-nassar for MCU Prep

relationshipReview.authorityIdentity: GPT-6 Astra (gpt-6-astra), central bounded source and relationship reviewer
relationshipReview.rationale: All30 originals retain source groups1/2/3/5 and the unnumbered Season One identity. Eight partial overlaps are intentional. The newly merged DarkWorld guide shares exactly Thor1966#337-345, IDs11665,11666,11667,11668,11669,11670,11671,11672,11673. Its distinct five-issue Thor Mighty Avenger opening and Ragnarok's separate SeasonOne/Ragnarok/PlanetHulk blocks make both film selections meaningful; retain those nine shared originals in each list. Ten shared comics with Thor2011 remain selected; the older Extremis instruction does not generalize. Planet Hulk#92-105, including exact27399#103, is the supplied block, not the broader Planet Hulk companion. No exact duplicate.

insertionReview.authorityIdentity: GPT-6 Astra (gpt-6-astra), central bounded source and relationship reviewer
insertionReview.rationale: On merged PhaseTwo main, insert all six guides in received order before doctor-strange-multiverse-of-madness, after the four newly merged owner guides without reordering or rewriting them. Independent dated film associations, including two for the single InfinityWar/Endgame guide, control MCU discovery rather than source-manifest order.
